purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: science lecture; vocabulary (汚染/支出/経緯/失わ/向かう) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 汚染は、自然を少しずつ失わせます。
lines.en: Pollution gradually causes the loss of nature.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 汚染の経緯は、調べられますか?
lines.en: Can the process of pollution be traced?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 記録から、経緯をたどれます。
lines.en: We can trace the process from records.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 森が、失われていくんですか?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、放っておくと失われます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 対策には、支出が要りますね。
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 支出を惜しまず、回復に向かいましょう。
lines.en: Without sparing spending, let's head toward recovery.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 自然を失わないよう、行動したいです。
lines.en: I want to act so we don't lose nature.
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, soft warm realization throughout
